title: Chirp's Grey Puddle
markdown:
Cheep! Cheep! Chirp the chick popped out of his nest, ready for a super fun day! The sunshine felt warm and tickly on his fuzzy yellow fluff. "Whee!" he chirped. His most favorite place in the whole meadow was the big puddle by the Whispering Willow tree. Usually, oh boy, it was SO pretty! It shimmered with red like ladybugs, blue like tiny flower petals, and yellow like yummy buttercups. It would wiggle and jiggle like a happy dance!

But today? Oh no! Chirp blinked his round, curious eyes. The puddle was… grey. Just grey. Like a sad, forgotten cloud that had dropped all its colors. Chirp tilted his head. "Where did the pretty colors go?" he peeped. He felt a little bit wobbly inside, like his tummy had lost its bounce.

He hopped, hop-hopped closer. His little feet went *pitter-patter* on the soft green grass. "Peep?" he whispered to the dull, plain water. He did a little hop and – *SPLISH!* A tiny bit of grey water splashed onto a daisy. But the puddle stayed grey. Chirp’s little chest felt all floppy, like a balloon that had lost its air. He sat down with a little sigh.

Then, he saw him! Curled up on a sunny patch of moss, fast asleep, was Nimbus! Nimbus the nap dragon! He was big and soft, like a fluffy sky cloud, all the color of a gentle rain shower. Nimbus LOVED shiny things, especially for his naps. His scales twinkled like dewdrops caught on a sparkly web, even when he was snoozing.

Chirp wiggled his fluffy bottom and tiptoed over. "Nimbus! Psst! Nimbus! Wakey-wakey!"

Nimbus’s long eyelashes fluttered open, like slow curtains. "Mmmph?" he mumbled. A little puff of sleepy air came out, smelling like warm sunshine and sweet dreams.

"The puddle!" Chirp peeped, his voice a little squeaky. "It's all grey now! All the colors are gone!"

Nimbus yawned. It sounded like a soft breeze rustling through the Whispering Willow’s leaves. "Grey?" he rumbled, his voice like a comfy hug. "Oh dear, oh dear. Grey needs… a sparkle! A shimmy! Let's make it shine!" Nimbus blinked his big, kind eyes, the color of a clear night sky. "I know! Shiny pebbles! They make my nap spot super twinkly. Come on, little Chirp! Let’s find some!"

Nimbus stretched his big, cloud-soft body, his wings giving a gentle flutter. "Shhh," he whispered, like a cozy lullaby. Chirp chirped happily, his wobbly tummy feeling bouncy again.

They waddled and fluttered to a little spot by a happy, babbling brook. Wow! Sparkly stones were scattered everywhere, like little fallen stars! There were stones that glittered like tiny diamonds, and some that shone like little round moons. Chirp picked up a beakful of the brightest, most sparkly pebbles. Nimbus nudged a few more with his soft, cloud-nose, very carefully.

Together, they trotted back to the sad, grey puddle.

"Ready?" Nimbus rumbled, his voice full of warm excitement. Chirp nodded, his fluffy head bobbing super fast.

"One, two, THREE!"

They dropped the shiny pebbles into the puddle. *PLINK! PLINK! SPARKLE-DING!*

And WOW! Oh, WOW! The grey melted away like magic! Swirls of happy red, bright blue, sunny yellow, and soft green danced and twirled. The puddle was a rainbow puddle again! It sparkled and winked in the sun, as happy as could be.

Chirp did a happy hop, his fluffy tail wiggling! "Hooray! Thank you, Nimbus! It's beautiful again!"

Nimbus curled up by the puddle, a happy sigh escaping him. His scales caught the new rainbow light. "Shiny pebbles make everything better," he mumbled, his eyes already drooping, ready for his extra-cozy, extra-sparkly nap. And so, a happy chick and a sleepy dragon, with a handful of sparkly stones, brought all the colors and cheer back to the puddle, making the whole meadow smile a little brighter. Cheep cheep!
characters: Chirp the chick, Nimbus the nap dragon
